_about: Billing questions shown at the bottom of Billing in LMS Dash and the client portal. From the standard Website Services Agreement. {monthly} becomes the client's monthly amount ('$365.00 a month'), or 'your monthly fee' when unknown. Edit here, then py scripts/sync_kit.py.

items.q: When do I get my monthly invoice?
items.a: Monthly services are billed in advance. Your invoice for {monthly} is sent on the 1st of each month.
Within 15 days, so by the 16th of the month. One-off work (like a website build) is due when you get the invoice.
By Interac e-Transfer, or by direct deposit using the details on your invoice. Once we receive it, it shows here as a payment and comes off your balance.

items.q: Can I pay part of an invoice?
items.a: Yes. Whatever you send comes off your oldest invoice first. If you pay more than you owe, the extra is kept as a credit for your next invoice.

items.q: What happens if I pay late?
items.a: Invoices unpaid after 30 days may be charged interest of 2% a month (26.8% a year). If an invoice is more than 30 days overdue, services (including hosting and email) can be paused after 7 days' written notice, and they resume once the account is paid.

items.q: How many changes are included each month?
items.a: Up to 5 hours of small edits a month (photos, wording, hours and similar). Unused hours don't roll over.

Once the 5 included hours are used, changes are $25.00 each. We always tell you before doing billable work, and it is added to your next monthly invoice. New pages, features or a redesign are quoted separately.
No. We are not registered for HST. If that changes, we will give you 30 days' written notice before adding it.
Monthly services run month to month with no long-term commitment. Give us 30 days' notice by email. You pay through the end of the notice period, with no cancellation fees.
Only with 30 days' written notice before a monthly fee changes.
